text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai F.S. has
arrived. I'm in
the waiting room, when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do we still have time? I'm out of
tape.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel right without it. Can't even
remember
when I started doing it.
choice_data_list: そういえば、いつも鼻につけてるな
そういえば、いつも鼻につけてるね

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, can I go buy some tape? I can
probably
just pick some up at a
convenience store since
they sell
everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's probably true, but Narita Brian
has already
changed clothes for the
race. She'll definitely
stand out if she
goes out like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's also not good to waste time with
stuff like this
right before a race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.
choice_data_list: 代わりに買ってくるよ

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The quality doesn't matter, just get the
cheapest
one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just to be sure, I check what brand she
usually
uses before heading to the shop
nearest to the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shelves contain a variety of brands,
from
well-established standbys to new
products
claiming to enhance
concentration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's even scented tape for relaxation,
and
others that stretch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What the heck? Did you buy out the
whole store
or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's not the point. Geez.
choice_data_list: ……自腹で買ったから、君は気にしないで
……自腹で買ったから、貴方は気にしないで

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
First of all, a trainer's contract only lasts
for three
years from the debut race. And
if you don't get
the results, that contract
can even be terminated
early.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yet you're out here wasting money
buying stacks
of tape. What are you
going to do if I go on a
losing streak and
you lose your contract?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: ブライアンなら負けない

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: ブライアンならどんな相手でも勝てる！

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haha... What's with the blind faith? Did
you hit
your head or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Well? Which tape is the best
for
concentration?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll try that one first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It feels okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This is racing. The first across the finish
line wins,
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't try and make me say that.
choice_data_list: 君ならどんな相手でも勝てる！
貴方ならどんな相手でも勝てる！

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Okay, fine... Whoever I'm up against, I'm
going to
tear them apart—victory will be
mine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's a lotta people here. I'd expect
nothin' less
of the Asahi Hai Futurity
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, Brian! Don't bore us out there
or I'll
come laugh in your face when
you're done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Asahi Hai F.S. is set to begin
under
the watchful eyes of a huge
crowd.
